definitions: A musical instrument, roughly triangular, consisting of a frame supporting a series of parallel strings, played by plucking with the fingers.
A small, often harmonica-like instrument, typically used in folk or blues music.
A type of often decorative, open-work frame or structure, resembling the shape of a harp.
examples: She played a beautiful melody on the harp.
He blew into the harp, creating a bluesy sound.
The bridge was supported by a harp of cables.
